**LANDEN TRANSFORMATIONS AND THE INTEGRATION OF RATIONAL FUNCTIONS**

*GEORGE BOROS AND VICTOR H. MOLL*

20 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** We present a rational version of the classical Landen transfor- mation for elliptic integrals. This is employed to obtain explicit closed-form expressions for a large class of integrals of even rational functions and to de- velop an algorithm for numerical integration of these functions.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 The reduction formula; 3 The quartic case; 4 The symmetric case of degree 8; 5 A sequence of Landen transformations; 6 The sixth degree case; 7 Examples; Appendix A. Two binomial sums; References
